name: Nguyễn Đình Chiểu tomb and memorial
nameVi: Lăng và đền thờ Nguyễn Đình Chiểu
kicker: Tomb and memorial of the poet at Ba Tri
summary: The tomb and memorial of Nguyễn Đình Chiểu at Ba Tri, listed a national historic relic on 27 April 1990. Come on 1 July, a solar date, or on an ordinary day when the ground is still the visit. Hours and a ticket were not printed. Check on arrival.

notice.title: 1 July is a solar date
notice.body: A lunar date sends you on the wrong day. On an ordinary day the ground is still the visit.

body: The tomb and memorial sit at old xã An Đức, 2 km from the center of thị trấn Ba Tri, on tỉnh lộ 885 through Giồng Trôm. Clause 83 of Nghị quyết 1687/NQ-UBTVQH15 merges thị trấn Ba Tri and the communes Vĩnh Hòa, An Đức, Vĩnh An, and An Bình Tây into xã Ba Tri. The clause does not say the tomb moved. The culture department’s site says the Ministry of Culture and Information listed it a national historic relic on 27 April 1990, on 13,000 m².

The birth date on that site is 1 July 1822. He was not born in Bến Tre. He lived and worked here. The culture program runs 30 June–2 July, and the day itself is 1 July on the solar calendar. The program includes đờn ca tài tử, a costume play of Lục Vân Tiên and Kiều Nguyệt Nga, recited verse, drum, traditional martial arts, a feast, and yard games. Hours and a ticket were not printed. Check on arrival. Drive minutes from the town are check on arrival.

gettingThere: The culture site places the ground 2 km from the center of thị trấn Ba Tri, on tỉnh lộ 885 through Giồng Trôm. That 2 km is not a distance from Ben Tre town. Drive minutes and a fare were not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Ben Tre
legs.body: By road on tỉnh lộ 885 through Giồng Trôm, then 2 km from the center of thị trấn Ba Tri. Minutes from Ben Tre were not printed. Check on arrival.
